sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Overview; Set it up; Engine support; Quickstart; License
sources.finding: CCC is a local dashboard and On-call preview that attaches to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Kilo Code, Kimi Code, OpenCode, Grok and Devin sessions; install via curl script, Homebrew, macOS DMG, Windows PowerShell; nothing hosted; FSL-1.1-MIT; one anonymous daily ping with CCC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 to turn off.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.locator: Functional Source License 1.1, MIT Future License
sources.finding: FSL-1.1-MIT, copyright Amir Fish: any purpose except Competing Use; each release converts to MIT on the second anniversary.

sources.title: SECURITY.md
sources.locator: Threat model; What we do to enforce the boundary; What we don't do
sources.finding: Single-user single-host loopback trust model, no accounts or permissions, headless Claude spawned with --dangerously-skip-permissions, optional Tailscale phone access with optional PIN, agent-config consent, no sandbox, no encryption at rest, no rate limiting.

sources.title: docs/engine-support.md
sources.finding: Nine spawnable engines with per-engine resume, transcript source and model/effort controls; Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot Chat read-only; Cursor IDE metadata only.

sources.title: docs/architecture.md
sources.locator: Persistent execution worker; Data sources; Data sinks
sources.finding: Stdlib Python server with vanilla JS UI; ccc-worker owns agent transports over a mode-0600 Unix socket with a SQLite control-plane ledger (idempotency keys, leases, uncertain state); sidecar JSON under ~/.claude/command-center.

sources.title: docs/cli.md
sources.finding: ccc sessions, spawn, send, ask, share, models, quota, doctor, vault, remind, app; reads port.txt for server base URL.

sources.title: docs/orchestration.md
sources.locator: Spawn a session; Read and ask
sources.finding: POST /api/sessions/spawn (engine, model, reasoning_effort, report_to, parent_session_id, idempotency_key), /api/ask, /api/inject-input, /api/usage/current; ccc-orchestration skill lets an agent spawn siblings and ask them.

sources.title: docs/QUEUES.md
sources.locator: What a queue is; basics; troubleshooting
sources.finding: WatchTower queues of tickets drained in parallel by workers, wt status/ls/drain/claim/close/release/wait, reconciler releases dead claims, wt config --workers N.

sources.title: docs/features.md
sources.locator: Organize and read work; Start and steer agents; Keep work moving; Costs; On-call; Phone access
sources.finding: Fleet list, Flow canvas, split conversations, board view, full-text search, fresh worktree spawns, permission prompts answered inline, queue inbox, plan-to-fleet, GitHub issue integration, Decision Inbox, usage tracking, free models, group chats, 12-skill pack.

sources.title: docs/kanban-rules.md
sources.finding: Board columns Backlog, Needs attention, Icebox, Working, Review, In Testing, Verified, Archived derived from sessions, GitHub issues and TODO.md.

sources.title: docs/session-attach.md
sources.finding: CCC reads each engine's own transcripts and live registries; hooks write live-state sidecars; closing CCC does not stop agents; headless spawns use claude -p stream-json with --dangerously-skip-permissions.

sources.title: docs/phone-access.md
sources.finding: Experimental Phone access wizard runs tailscale serve to expose the dashboard on the tailnet, QR code, optional PIN; phone uses the browser dashboard.

sources.title: ios-app/README.md
sources.finding: Capacitor WKWebView iOS shell that connects to the HTTPS phone URL; built by the user in Xcode, no store release documented.

sources.title: scripts/macapp/main.swift
sources.locator: File header; imports Cocoa WebKit Sparkle
sources.finding: Native macOS shell is a thin WKWebView around the localhost dashboard, can point at a remote CCC server, installs the server on first launch, updates with Sparkle.

sources.title: vscode-extension/package.json
sources.finding: VS Code extension 0.1.0 (MIT) with commands claudeCommandCenter.spawnSession and openDashboard; talks to a local CCC server.

sources.title: docs/worktree-init.md
sources.finding: Worktree toggle creates <parent>/<repo>-wt/<slug>/ on feat/<slug>; optional executable .ccc/worktree-init runs once with CCC_WORKTREE_PATH, CCC_PARENT_REPO, CCC_SESSION_NAME.

sources.title: docs/telemetry.md
sources.finding: One anonymous daily beacon (schema_version, version, platform, two booleans), no install id, CCC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 is the only switch; opt-in ping retired 2026-09-28.

sources.title: docs/byok-and-vault.md
sources.finding: Provider API keys in named profiles in Settings > Engines; Vault for other secrets.

sources.title: docs/free-models.md
sources.finding: Local freellmapi router on 127.0.0.1 forwards agent requests to free LLM providers; $0 runs; keyless provider may log prompts for training.

sources.title: docs/tos-boundary.md
sources.finding: CCC runs the user's installed claude CLI with its own login, reads plan usage about every 5 minutes, never shares the login.

sources.title: docs/usage-db.md
sources.finding: Local SQLite throughput database with per-session tokens and list-price cost across Claude Code, Codex and Kimi; plan fees, runrate, breakeven; read-only on source stores.

sources.title: docs/allowances.md
sources.finding: Allowances app keeps multiple Codex accounts with separate CLI homes, quota reads, automatic model-based account moves; new sessions can pick an account.

sources.title: docs/plan-to-fleet.md
sources.finding: wt import turns a Markdown plan into WatchTower tickets with dependency order after preview and approval; Drain starts workers.

sources.title: docs/oncall.md
sources.locator: Where bugs come from; replies; customer approval
sources.finding: On-call (preview, off by default) files tickets from email, GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, URL checks and commands, messages owner over email/Telegram/ntfy/iMessage/SMS/WhatsApp, replies become agent answers, customer messages need approval.

sources.title: docs/oncall-reliability.md
sources.finding: On-call stores send intent before side effects, reports queues WatchTower marks stuck, does not restart or reassign work.

sources.title: docs/cloud-relay/README.md
sources.finding: Optional account-based hosted relay that shows a minimized status snapshot to a phone browser and returns bounded actions; the laptop remains the execution environment.

sources.title: docs/cloud-relay/SECURITY-AND-PRIVACY.md
sources.finding: Hosted relay holds routing metadata only; wire contract and hosted service are not in this repository.

sources.title: docs/group-chat-pinging.md
sources.finding: Group chats ping participants on a post; watcher 30 s tick, 60 s throttle.

sources.title: docs/decision-memory.md
sources.finding: ccc decisions and Ask retrieve captured user decision quotes with transcript path, line and engine; read-only ccc-state MCP tool.

sources.title: docs/agent-config-consent.md
sources.finding: CCC writes hooks and skills into agent config only after per-item approval with diff and backups.

sources.title: docs/decision-inbox.md
sources.finding: Decision Inbox lists owner questions and stalled work from queues and sessions; answering disabled by default.

sources.title: ccc_server/runaway.py
sources.finding: Detects sessions that keep waking autonomously without productive turns or over budget; flagged for the owner.

sources.title: docs/sharing.md
sources.finding: ccc share builds a redacted replay page and image locally; nothing is uploaded.

sources.title: docs/install.md
sources.finding: Install paths for macOS, Linux (systemd user service), WSL2, native Windows (foreground) and Docker.

sources.title: CHANGELOG.md
sources.finding: Release notes for v5.46.0 including Antigravity accounts, apps, routines and CI display.

sources.title: .github/workflows/ci.yml
sources.finding: CI runs the Python test suite, JS checks and the telemetry worker tests on each push.

sources.title: docs/periodic-triggers.md
sources.finding: Dashboard UI pollers (1 s to 60 s) refresh sessions, issues and deploy pills; these are UI refresh timers, not agent schedulers.

sources.title: control_plane.py
sources.finding: Control-plane ledger with idempotency keys, leases and parent-child edges for worker-owned spawns and turns.

sources.title: hooks/permission-request.py
sources.finding: Claude Code PermissionRequest hook feeding the dashboard approval prompts.

sources.title: ccc_server/engines.py
sources.finding: Engine spawn code takes worktree option and records effective worktree kind.

sources.title: ccc_server/fleet_jobs.py
sources.locator: gh pr merge --squash and git merge --ff-only
sources.finding: Fleet jobs run gh pr merge --squash and fast-forward merges as dashboard actions.

sources.title: server.py
sources.finding: Server detects PRs created by sessions (gh pr create) and offers merge (gh pr merge --squash) and verify/archive actions with GitHub issue linking.
